purpose: Teach: 引き継ぐ/ジュエリー/賜物/見積り/雄大/摘出/要所/国税庁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 退任する社員の業務、本気で、絶対、引き継ぐ、絶対、よう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When staff retire, I need you to take over their work completely—no shortcuts, no excuses. Make sure it's done right.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding opening. Sharp consonants on key words. Measured tempo with weight behind each clause. No room for negotiation. Formal but direct—the authority of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、ジュエリー、絶対、新作、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our new jewelry line is receiving excellent feedback from customers. We're grateful for your confidence in us.
lines.style: Respectful, steady report. Alert posture—standing slightly taller. Words precise and measured, like reading from a mental checklist. No hesitation, no embellishment. Professional deference without servility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お父さんの代からの、本気で、絶対、賜物、絶対、当社の伝統、絶対、守れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: This company has a legacy going back to my father's generation. Protect that tradition—that's what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Deliberate and weighty. Slight slowdown on the inheritance part, like the words carry history. Quiet intensity underneath—not loud, but unmissable. A man speaking about something that matters deeply.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、見積り、絶対、迅速に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're handling customer quotations swiftly and with care. That's a priority we understand completely.
lines.style: Attentive and engaged. Slight nod in the voice—confirming understanding. Tempo quickens slightly to show readiness. Earnest but not over-eager. The tone of someone taking a directive seriously and already thinking about implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、雄大、絶対、なビジョン、絶対、社員に、絶対、伝えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure every person on this team understands the vision we're building—our ambition for this company. That's your responsibility.
lines.style: Firmer now, with an undercurrent of frustration. Opening attack is clean and sharp. Slightly faster pace than before. The tone of a leader who expects this message to actually reach people, not just be heard. Steel beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営の問題点、本気で、絶対、摘出、絶対、対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're identifying the management issues we're facing and putting solutions in place. That work is ongoing.
lines.style: Calm, methodical delivery. No rush. Words spaced with slight breath between clauses—showing thoughtfulness, not hesitation. Confident without being defensive. The tone of someone reporting progress, not making excuses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販売戦略の、本気で、絶対、要所、絶対、押さえろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Get the fundamentals of our sales strategy right. Handle the critical points yourself. Don't let that slip.
lines.style: Sharp and direct. Slight hardening on the key directive. Tempo controlled but no softening. The tone of someone giving one final instruction that will not be repeated. Expectation of compliance without discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国税庁、本気で、絶対、より、絶対、ご指導、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're receiving guidance from the National Tax Agency and implementing their recommendations carefully.
lines.style: Final note—composed but with subtle relief undertones. Measured and respectful. Slightly more relaxed than previous responses, knowing this concludes the exchange. Professional close with a hint of quiet confidence. The tone of someone who has done their job and can stand behind it.
